subject: Post-discovery recap & pick 30m preview slot

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia@helixdata.com>
Cc: Daniel Price <daniel.price@helixdata.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery recap & pick 30m preview slot

Hi Alicia / Daniel,

Thanks again for the call today — great context on Helix Data's model-serving bottlenecks and the compliance requirements for your analytics workloads. Quick recap so we have alignment:  

- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for your customer-facing search experience and cut per-token cost for nightly bulk transforms.
- Must-haves: VPC/private deployment option, audit logs + KMS integration, predictable throughput for concurrent queries (~200 qps during peak).
- Success metric: sub-300ms 95th percentile on median query patterns, and a clear plan to reduce unit cost by ~30% through batching/caching.

Next step: we'd like to run a 30-minute compact preview (product demo + high-level ops checklist) with your engineering + security reps. Two suggested windows (PT):
1) Tue Jan 20, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
2) Wed Jan 21, 2:00–2:30 PM PT

If neither fits, share two windows that work for your team and we'll adapt. Can you also confirm who from your infra/security team should join (we recommend an infra owner and a security reviewer)?

I attached the discovery notes and a short MVP use-case spreadsheet for review. Ben (solutions engineer) will join the demo to cover latency tuning and quantization tradeoffs; Neha (CS) will cover onboarding and success milestones.

Proposed agenda (30m) — compact:
- 0–5m: quick introductions & priorities
- 5–20m: targeted preview (latency/cost features + routing/fallbacks)
- 20–25m: security/ops checklist (KMS, VPC options, audit logs)
- 25–30m: next steps & mutual action items

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary), mvp-use-cases.xlsx (2-page)
